Design, documentation, standalone auditing, localization, suite creation versus execution, release assessment, post-release operations, Sprint bundles, context auditing and tier validation retain distinct outcomes instead of acquiring generic implementation or testing chains.

Existing attachment skips shipping prerequisites, supplied logs resume their monitor, local findings suppress posting, and recommendation performs no Git/GitHub action.

Static assertions cover specialist inputs/stops, conditional controls, side effects, retired identities, missing dependencies and honest verification claims without claiming model-generation evidence. Canonical level 2 now correctly distinguishes manual verification, LIGHT sanity checks and observed tests. Distribution and core-copy parity remain mandatory Task7 work, not waived.
